name: Vanta
description: Connect your own Vanta organization (OAuth2 Client Credentials) to monitor compliance Tests/Controls/Frameworks, manage the Risk Register and Vendor risk inventory, review Policy documents and Personnel compliance status, and get an aggregated audit-readiness health report.

tools.name: connect_vanta
tools.description: Connect a Vanta organization via OAuth2 Client Credentials (API application), after verifying connectivity.

label.description: Friendly organization label, e.g. 'Acme Corp — Production'.
label.title: Label

client_id.description: Vanta API application Client ID, from Settings > API.
client_id.title: Client Id

base_url.description: Optional API base URL override for segregated tenants. Defaults to https://api.vanta.com.
base_url.title: Base Url

tools.name: disconnect_vanta
tools.description: Disconnect a Vanta organization: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in Vanta itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved Vanta organization connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Vanta organizations.

tools.name: list_tests
tools.description: List automated compliance Tests (control checks) with their status (OK/FAIL/DISABLED/OUTDATED/NOT_APPLICABLE).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional status filter: OK, FAIL, DISABLED, OUTDATED, NOT_APPLICABLE.
status.title: Status

page_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_page_cursor.
page_cursor.title: Page Cursor

tools.name: get_test
tools.description: Read one compliance Test in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: dismiss_test
tools.description: Dismiss a failing Test with a documented reason -- records an explicit exception/justification in Vanta rather than silently ignoring the failure.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

reason.description: Reason for dismissing this test (recorded in Vanta as justification).
reason.title: Reason

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: List Controls (named requirements mapped to one or more frameworks, each backed by 1+ Tests).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

framework_id.description: Optional framework ID to filter controls to one framework.
framework_id.title: Framework Id

page_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_page_cursor.
page_cursor.title: Page Cursor

tools.name: get_control
tools.description: Read one Control in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_frameworks
tools.description: List compliance Frameworks enabled on the connected organization (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, etc.).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_risks
tools.description: List Risk Register entries.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

page_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_page_cursor.
page_cursor.title: Page Cursor

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Read one Risk Register entry in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_risk
tools.description: Create a new Risk Register entry.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

risk_scenario_id.description: Optional risk scenario/category ID to tie this risk to.
risk_scenario_id.title: Risk Scenario Id

tools.name: update_risk
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Risk Register entry (status, treatment plan). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

title.description: New title, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
title.title: Title

description.description: New description, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
description.title: Description

status.description: New status, e.g. 'open', 'closed', 'accepted', 'monitoring'. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
status.title: Status

likelihood.description: New likelihood score 1-5, or 0 to keep unchanged.
likelihood.title: Likelihood

impact.description: New impact score 1-5, or 0 to keep unchanged.
impact.title: Impact

tools.name: list_risk_scenarios
tools.description: List Risk Scenarios (the named risk categories Risk Register entries can be tied to).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: List Vendor risk inventory (third-party risk management) entries.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

page_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_page_cursor.
page_cursor.title: Page Cursor

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: Read one Vendor risk record in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_vendor
tools.description: Register a new Vendor for risk tracking.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

description.description: What this vendor is used for.
description.title: Description

tools.name: update_vendor
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Vendor (risk tier, review status). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Vanta organization connection ID. Omit to use the first connected organization.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

risk_tier.description: New risk tier, e.g. 'critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
risk_tier.title: Risk Tier

status.description: New review status. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
status.title: Status

page_cursor.title: Page Cursor

tools.name: get_person

tools.description: List connected data-source Integrations (cloud/IdP/HR/ticketing) Vanta pulls evidence from, with their sync status.

secrets.name: vanta_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Vanta organizations and encrypted OAuth2 Client Credentials. Managed only through connect_vanta and disconnect_vanta.

pricing.notes: Standard platform scale {0, 8, 16, 20, 40}. 0 = access setup and harmless discovery. 8 = read/list/search. 16 = standard single mutation/CRUD. 20 = bulk or heavy audit operation.
